title: 米約高架橋~Millau Viaduct
focus: 以高墩、多跨斜張與鋼箱梁頂推，在 270 公尺高的河谷上完成 2,460 公尺連續橋面~Tall piers, multi-span cable stays and a launched steel box deck delivering a 2,460 m continuous deck about 270 m above a valley
summary: 米約高架橋以七座混凝土高墩、七座鋼塔與 2,460 公尺連續鋼箱梁跨越法國塔恩河谷，最高墩約 245 公尺、塔頂高 343 公尺。本課從河谷高空風與多跨斜張體系的勁度問題出發，分析雙肢橋墩、正交異性鋼箱梁與 154 根單股斜索，再拆解由兩岸頂推、經臨時鋼墩把跨徑減半的施工法與合龍，最後談斜索監測、載重試驗、鋼橋面疲勞與特許經營期的維護。~The Millau Viaduct crosses the Tarn valley in France on seven concrete piers, seven steel pylons and a 2,460 m continuous steel box deck, with the tallest pier about 245 m and the pylon tops at 343 m. The course starts with high-level valley wind and the stiffness problem of multi-span cable-stayed bridges, examines split-shaft piers, the orthotropic steel box and 154 monostrand stays, then unpacks launching from both abutments over temporary towers that halve the spans and the closure, ending with stay monitoring, load testing, deck fatigue and maintenance through the concession.

units.title: 塔恩河谷高空風與行車安全~Valley wind and traffic safety
units.mechanism: 米約高架橋的橋面距塔恩河最高約 270 公尺，河谷地形使強風加速並伴隨陣風，風荷載同時作用在鋼箱梁、橋墩、鋼塔與 154 根斜索上。對結構而言，橫向風力經箱梁傳到支承與墩頂，再由高墩以彎矩傳到基礎；對使用者而言，側風會讓高車身車輛偏移或傾覆，因此橋面兩側設置風屏，以降低車道上的風速。風屏本身卻增加了箱梁的受風面積與阻力，必須在風洞試驗中同時評估行車舒適與結構風載的取捨。~The Millau deck stands up to about 270 m above the Tarn, and the valley topography accelerates strong winds and gusts that act at once on the steel box girder, piers, pylons and 154 stays. Structurally, lateral wind on the deck passes through bearings to the pier heads and then down the tall piers as bending to the foundations; for users, crosswinds push or overturn high-sided vehicles, so wind screens line both deck edges to cut wind speed over the lanes. The screens add exposed area and drag to the girder, so wind-tunnel testing must weigh traffic comfort against structural wind load.
units.model: 風壓 q = ½ρV²。取 V = 50 m/s、ρ = 1.225 kg/m³，q = 0.5×1.225×50² ≈ 1,531 Pa。箱梁深 4.2 m 加上風屏等效高度共 7.2 m、阻力係數 C_D = 1.3，每公尺橫向力 = 1,531×1.3×7.2 ≈ 14.3 kN/m；一個 342 m 跨約 4,900 kN。風速、等效高度與 C_D 為教學假設。~Wind pressure q = ½ρV². With V = 50 m/s and ρ = 1.225 kg/m³, q = 0.5×1.225×50² ≈ 1,531 Pa. Taking the 4.2 m box plus screens as an equivalent 7.2 m height with C_D = 1.3, the lateral force is 1,531×1.3×7.2 ≈ 14.3 kN/m, about 4,900 kN on one 342 m span. Wind speed, equivalent height and C_D are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以斷面模型風洞試驗量測有無風屏時的阻力、升力與力矩係數，並以全橋氣動彈性模型或分析確認抖振反應；營運期以橋面風速計記錄實際風速與陣風因子，與設計風況比較，並作為交通限制的依據。~Measure drag, lift and moment coefficients with and without screens in sectional wind-tunnel tests, and confirm buffeting response with a full aeroelastic model or analysis; in service, deck anemometers record actual mean speeds and gust factors for comparison with design winds and as the basis for traffic restrictions.
units.failure: 若只以風屏改善行車條件而未把風屏阻力納入結構設計，強風下橋墩彎矩與支承橫向力會超出預期；反之若風屏孔隙設計不當，車道風速降不下來，強風時只能封橋，交通可靠度大打折扣。~Adding screens for traffic without including their drag in structural design lets pier moments and lateral bearing forces exceed predictions in storms; conversely, poorly designed screen porosity fails to reduce lane wind speeds, forcing closures in strong winds and undermining reliability.
units.misconception: 風屏只是保護駕駛的附屬設施，不會影響主結構受力。~Wind screens are just driver-protection fittings and do not affect the main structure.
units.practice: 風屏的孔隙率、高度與固定方式應與結構設計同一批風洞試驗決定，更換或改型須經結構工程師重新檢核；交通管理單位應依橋面實測風速建立分級限制程序並定期檢討。~Screen porosity, height and fixing should be fixed in the same wind-tunnel campaign as the structure, and any replacement or redesign re-checked by the structural engineer; the operator should base staged traffic restrictions on measured deck wind speeds and review them periodically.

units.anchor: 雙肢橋墩上段~Split upper pier shafts
units.title: 多跨斜張體系與橋墩勁度~Multi-span stays and pier stiffness
units.mechanism: 一般斜張橋靠錨碇跨把背索固定在地面，塔頂水平位移受控；米約有六個 342 公尺主跨連續排列，中間各塔沒有錨碇跨，活載只放在某一跨時，塔頂會被拉向受載跨，箱梁與橋墩必須提供勁度抵抗這種不對稱變形。另一方面，長 2,460 公尺的連續鋼梁隨溫度伸縮，墩頂被強迫水平位移，若橋墩太剛就會產生很大的彎矩。設計者的解法是讓每座墩在上部約 90 公尺分成兩肢：兩肢組成的框架對不對稱活載提供彎曲勁度，單肢較細又能柔和地跟隨梁體伸縮。~A conventional cable-stayed bridge ties its back stays to the ground through anchor spans, limiting tower-top sway; Millau has six 342 m main spans in a row, so the inner pylons have no anchor spans, and live load on one span pulls the pylon tops toward it, requiring the deck and piers to resist this unbalanced deformation. At the same time the 2,460 m continuous steel deck expands and contracts with temperature, forcing horizontal displacement at the pier heads, which would create large moments in a very stiff pier. The designers split the upper part of each pier, about 90 m, into two shafts: acting as a frame they give bending stiffness against unbalanced live load, while each slender shaft follows the deck's thermal movement more gently.
units.model: 假設梁體以中央 P4 附近為不動點，P1 與 P4 之間為三個主跨，距不動點 3×342 = 1,026 m。鋼的 α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C、溫差 35 °C：墩頂強迫位移 Δ = α·L·ΔT = 1.2×10⁻⁵×1,026×35 ≈ 0.431 m。若把實心墩頭剖成兩片各為一半深度的薄肢，單肢慣性矩為原來的 1/8，兩肢獨立彎曲時合計約 1/4。不動點與溫差為教學假設。~Assume the deck is fixed near the central pier P4, so P1, three main spans away, lies 3×342 = 1,026 m from it. With steel α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C and a 35 °C range, the imposed pier-head movement is Δ = α·L·ΔT = 1.2×10⁻⁵×1,026×35 ≈ 0.431 m. Splitting a solid head into two leaves of half depth gives each leaf 1/8 of the original second moment, about 1/4 for both bending independently. Fixed point and temperature range are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以考慮幾何非線性的全橋模型，分別計算單跨滿載、隔跨滿載與溫度工況下的塔頂位移、墩底彎矩與箱梁應力；施工中以 GNSS 與傾斜儀量測墩頂位移與溫度的關係，與模型預測比對。~Use a geometrically nonlinear whole-bridge model to compute pylon-top sway, pier-base moments and deck stresses for one span loaded, alternate spans loaded and temperature cases; during construction measure pier-head movement against temperature with GNSS and inclinometers and compare with predictions.
units.failure: 若橋墩只為溫度變形設計得很柔，不對稱活載下塔頂位移過大、箱梁撓度與彎矩超出容許；若為了勁度做得太剛，溫度伸縮會在墩底產生巨大彎矩與裂縫，兩者都無法單靠加大斷面解決。~Piers made very flexible for thermal movement let pylon tops sway excessively under unbalanced live load, overstressing and over-deflecting the deck; piers made very stiff for live load develop huge base moments and cracks from thermal movement, and neither problem is solved simply by enlarging sections.
units.misconception: 橋墩越粗越剛，多跨斜張橋就越安全。~The thicker and stiffer the piers, the safer a multi-span cable-stayed bridge becomes.
units.practice: 多跨斜張橋的設計基準應明列不對稱活載排列與溫度組合，並把墩、塔、梁的勁度比例當成設計參數做敏感度分析；施工監測計畫須指定墩頂位移的預警值與量測溫度條件。~The design basis for a multi-span cable-stayed bridge should list unbalanced live-load patterns with temperature combinations and treat the pier–pylon–deck stiffness ratio as a parameter in sensitivity studies; the monitoring plan should define pier-head movement alert values and the temperature conditions for measurement.

units.anchor: 中央箱梁高強度鋼板~High-strength central box plate
units.title: 正交異性鋼箱梁與高強度鋼~Orthotropic steel box and high-strength steel
units.mechanism: 米約的橋面是梯形斷面的正交異性鋼箱梁，深 4.20 公尺、寬約 32 公尺，由中央箱與兩側面板組成，總重約 36,000 公噸。頂板以縱向加勁肋與橫隔板支撐，同時作為行車面、箱梁上翼板與斜索錨碇區的傳力板。鋼材供應商資料顯示，接近一半的鋼材採用 460 MPa 等級的 DI-MC 460，用於中央箱、面板、鋼塔與塔腳，其餘為 S355；在受力大的位置用高強度鋼可以減少板厚與自重，對頂推與斜索都有利，但焊接程序與韌性要求更嚴格。~Millau's deck is a trapezoidal orthotropic steel box 4.20 m deep and about 32 m wide, made of a central box and side panels, weighing about 36,000 t. The top plate, stiffened by longitudinal ribs and cross-diaphragms, is at once the running surface, the box's top flange and the load-spreading plate at stay anchorages. The steel supplier reports that almost half of the steel was DI-MC 460, a 460 MPa grade, used in the central box, panels, pylons and pylon feet, with S355 elsewhere; high-strength plate where forces are large cuts thickness and self-weight, helping both launching and the stays, but demands stricter welding procedures and toughness.
units.model: 全橋鋼梁約 36,000 t / 2,460 m ≈ 14.6 t/m。若某段下翼板需傳遞 60 MN 壓力：S355 需 A = 60×10⁶/355×10⁶ ≈ 0.169 m²（約 1,327 kg/m），S460 需 0.130 m²（約 1,024 kg/m），節省約 23%。60 MN 為教學假設，未計穩定折減。~The deck averages about 36,000 t / 2,460 m ≈ 14.6 t/m. If a bottom flange must carry 60 MN of compression, S355 needs A = 60×10⁶/355×10⁶ ≈ 0.169 m² (about 1,327 kg/m) while S460 needs 0.130 m² (about 1,024 kg/m), a saving of about 23%. The 60 MN is a teaching assumption, ignoring stability reductions.
units.verify: 鋼板到廠時核對材質證明的強度、衝擊韌性與化學成分，焊接前做焊接程序評定（含熱影響區韌性）；板件製作後以超音波或相位陣列檢查全滲透焊道，並以尺寸量測確認面板、加勁肋與橫隔板的幾何允差。~On delivery check mill certificates for strength, impact toughness and chemistry, qualify welding procedures including heat-affected-zone toughness, and after fabrication inspect full-penetration welds by ultrasonic or phased-array testing while measuring panels, ribs and diaphragms against dimensional tolerances.
units.failure: 高強度鋼若沿用一般鋼的焊接預熱與入熱，熱影響區可能變脆或產生氫致裂紋；面板與加勁肋尺寸偏差過大時，頂推經過墩頂的局部集中力會使腹板或底板屈曲。~Welding high-strength plate with ordinary-steel preheat and heat input can embrittle the heat-affected zone or cause hydrogen cracking; panels and ribs outside tolerance can buckle webs or bottom plates under the concentrated forces as the deck passes over each support during launching.
units.misconception: 全部改用高強度鋼一定最省錢、最安全。~Using high-strength steel everywhere is always the cheapest and safest choice.
units.practice: 材料規格應依部位指定鋼級與韌性等級，並把焊接程序評定、預熱控制與無損檢測比例寫入製造規範；高強度鋼的修補焊須經焊接工程師核准，不得現場臨時決定。~The material specification should assign steel grade and toughness class by location and write procedure qualification, preheat control and inspection rates into the fabrication specification; repair welding of high-strength steel must be approved by the welding engineer, never improvised on site.

units.anchor: 單股鋼絞線斜索~Monostrand stay cables
units.title: 154 根斜索與錨碇設計~The 154 stays and their anchorages
units.mechanism: 七座鋼塔各以單一索面、半扇形配置 22 根斜索，全橋共 154 根，每根由 55 至 91 股直徑 15.7 mm 的鋼絞線組成，鋼絞線熱浸鍍鋅、塗蠟並各自包覆高密度聚乙烯，鋼絞線抗拉強度 1,860 MPa，斜索鋼材合計約 1,500 公噸。單股可個別張拉、檢查與更換，是長期維護的關鍵。公開技術文章指出，米約斜索在使用荷載下工作在保證破斷強度的 50%，高於一般常用的 45%，因此錨具的疲勞與彎曲應力限制特別嚴格。~Each of the seven steel pylons carries 22 stays in a single central plane and semi-fan layout, 154 in all, each made of 55 to 91 strands of 15.7 mm diameter that are hot-dip galvanised, waxed and individually sheathed in high-density polyethylene, with 1,860 MPa strength and about 1,500 t of stay steel in total. Strands can be stressed, inspected and replaced one by one, which is central to long-term maintenance. A published technical paper states that the stays work at 50% of guaranteed breaking strength under service loads, above the usual 45%, so fatigue and bending-stress limits at the anchorages are especially strict.
units.model: 以單股面積 150 mm² 計，91 股斜索的保證破斷力 = 91×150×1,860 ≈ 25,400 kN；50% 時使用索力約 12,700 kN，45% 時約 11,400 kN。55 股的破斷力 55×150×1,860 ≈ 15,345 kN，其 99% 約 15,190 kN，與公開的 15,220 kN 試驗力同量級。單股面積為教學假設。~Taking 150 mm² per strand, a 91-strand stay has a guaranteed breaking load of 91×150×1,860 ≈ 25,400 kN, so 50% gives about 12,700 kN in service versus about 11,400 kN at 45%. A 55-strand stay breaks at 55×150×1,860 ≈ 15,345 kN, and 99% of that, about 15,190 kN, matches the published 15,220 kN test load in magnitude. Strand area is a teaching assumption.
units.verify: 以原型斜索做疲勞試驗（公開資料：55 股索以 200 MPa 應力幅、200 萬次循環）後再拉到接近破斷，確認錨具效率；現場以等張力法逐股張拉並以測力計或頻率法驗證每根索力，記錄溫度與施工階段。~Fatigue-test prototype stays (published: a 55-strand stay at a 200 MPa stress range for 2 million cycles) and then pull them close to failure to confirm anchorage efficiency; on site stress strand by strand to equal force and verify each stay with load cells or frequency methods, recording temperature and construction stage.
units.failure: 錨具出口的彎曲若未限制，鋼絞線在錨口反覆彎折會提早疲勞斷絲；保護套破損讓水進入時，鍍鋅層與蠟逐漸失效，腐蝕集中在錨頭附近不易看到的位置。~Unrestrained bending at the anchorage exit flexes strands repeatedly and causes early fatigue wire breaks; a damaged sheath that admits water slowly defeats the zinc and wax, concentrating corrosion near anchorages where it is hard to see.
units.misconception: 斜索容許應力越高越好，只要強度夠就不必考慮疲勞。~The higher the allowable stay stress the better; fatigue need not be checked if strength is sufficient.
units.practice: 斜索系統應有完整的認證試驗（疲勞、靜力、防水），施工規範要求逐股張拉紀錄、錨頭灌注或封蓋檢查與保護套完整性檢查；預留可更換單股的空間與千斤頂操作淨空。~The stay system needs full qualification tests for fatigue, static strength and watertightness; the specification should require strand-by-strand stressing records, inspection of anchor caps and fillers and sheath integrity checks, and keep clearance for replacing single strands with jacks.

units.anchor: 頂推器與臨時鋼墩~Launching units and temporary towers
units.title: 雙向頂推與臨時墩~Launching from both sides over temporary towers
units.mechanism: 鋼箱梁在兩岸平台上組裝，由南岸頂推約 1,743 公尺、北岸約 717 公尺。342 公尺的主跨在頂推階段過長，因此在每跨中央設置可伸縮的臨時鋼墩，把懸臂長度減為約 171 公尺，最高的臨時墩約 170–180 公尺；橫跨塔恩河的 P2–P3 跨沒有臨時墩，改以先裝在 P2、P3 上的鋼塔與預先安裝的永久斜索承托懸臂。每座墩頂的頂推器先把梁頂起再向前推，公開報導稱每個循環推進 600 mm、約 4 分鐘，全程共 18 次頂推作業，由中央控制室同步各墩。~The steel deck was assembled on platforms at both ends and launched about 1,743 m from the south and 717 m from the north. The 342 m spans were too long for launching, so telescopic temporary steel towers at mid-span cut the cantilever to about 171 m, the tallest roughly 170–180 m high; the P2–P3 span over the Tarn had no temporary tower and the cantilever was carried instead by pylons already fitted on P2 and P3 with permanent stays installed in advance. A launching unit on each support lifted the deck and pushed it forward; trade reports cite 600 mm per cycle in about four minutes, with 18 launch operations in all, synchronised from a central control room.
units.model: 鋼梁自重 w ≈ 14.6 t/m×9.81 ≈ 143.6 kN/m。無鼻樑時 171 m 懸臂根部彎矩 M = w·L²/2 = 143.6×171²/2 ≈ 2.10×10⁶ kN·m，是同跨簡支跨中彎矩 w·L²/8 ≈ 5.25×10⁵ kN·m 的 4 倍。每循環 600 mm、4 分鐘，推過 171 m 需 285 個循環，約 19 小時純推進時間（約 9 m/h）。~Deck self-weight w ≈ 14.6 t/m×9.81 ≈ 143.6 kN/m. Without a nose, a 171 m cantilever has a root moment M = w·L²/2 = 143.6×171²/2 ≈ 2.10×10⁶ kN·m, four times the simple-span mid-span moment w·L²/8 ≈ 5.25×10⁵ kN·m. At 600 mm per four-minute cycle, 171 m needs 285 cycles, about 19 hours of pushing (about 9 m/h).
units.verify: 每次頂推前確認風速預報與允許窗口，頂推中即時監測各頂推器的頂升力、推力與梁底高程，並以測量確認懸臂端到達下一支點時的下垂量與鼻樑回收；臨時墩的伸縮與垂直度在每段頂推後重新量測。~Before each launch confirm the wind forecast and permitted window; during launching monitor lift and push forces and soffit levels at every unit in real time, survey the cantilever tip sag and nose recovery as it reaches the next support, and re-measure temporary-tower extension and verticality after each launch.
units.failure: 若各墩頂推器不同步，梁體在某一支點被拖拉或卡住，臨時墩頂受到額外水平力而傾斜；懸臂端下垂超出鼻樑可回收的範圍時，梁無法上到下一支點，只能停在最危險的長懸臂狀態等待處理。~If the units fall out of sync, the deck drags or jams at one support and a temporary tower takes extra horizontal force and tilts; if tip sag exceeds what the nose can recover, the deck cannot ride onto the next support and is stuck in its most critical long-cantilever state.
units.misconception: 頂推只是把梁往前推，主要風險是推力不夠。~Launching is just pushing the deck forward, and the main risk is insufficient push force.
units.practice: 頂推作業程序應列出天候窗口、每循環的停止條件（推力、頂升力、偏位、風速超限）、通訊失效時的安全狀態，以及每段頂推完成後的檢查清單；啟動每次頂推須由施工工程師與設計代表共同簽核。~The launching procedure should set weather windows, stop criteria per cycle (push or lift force, misalignment, wind speed), a safe state on loss of communication and an inspection checklist after each launch; every launch is released only with joint sign-off by the construction engineer and the designer's representative.

units.anchor: 河谷中央合龍段~Mid-valley closure joint
units.title: 合龍、鋼塔與斜索就位~Closure, pylons and stays in place
units.mechanism: 南北兩段鋼梁在 2004 年 5 月 28 日於塔恩河上方約 268 公尺處接合，之後才把各鋼塔與其餘斜索安裝到位：公開資料指出，頂推階段先在 P3、P2 安裝 24 根頂推用斜索，其餘 130 根在 2004 年 6 月至 8 月間安裝。合龍前兩段鋼梁都是自由端，溫度變化直接改變間隙與高程差；合龍後梁成為連續體，再透過斜索張拉把恆載重新分配，並把臨時墩卸載移除。這個體系轉換的順序決定最終梁體應力與線形。~The north and south deck sections met on 28 May 2004 about 268 m above the Tarn, after which the remaining pylons and stays were completed: published data say 24 launching stays were first installed on P3 and P2, and the other 130 between June and August 2004. Before closure both deck ends are free, so temperature directly changes the gap and level difference; after closure the deck is continuous, stay tensioning redistributes dead load and the temporary towers are unloaded and removed. The sequence of this system change determines final deck stresses and profile.
units.model: 南段長 1,743 m，鋼的 α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C，每 1 °C 端部伸縮 = 1.2×10⁻⁵×1,743 ≈ 0.0209 m = 20.9 mm；兩段若溫差 5 °C，間隙改變約 105 mm。因此合龍常選在夜間或清晨溫度穩定時，以臨時連接器先鎖定再焊接。溫差為教學假設。~The south section is 1,743 m long; with α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C its end moves 1.2×10⁻⁵×1,743 ≈ 0.0209 m = 20.9 mm per °C, so a 5 °C change shifts the gap by about 105 mm. Closure is therefore made at night or dawn when temperatures are stable, locking with temporary connectors before welding. The temperature change is a teaching assumption.
units.verify: 合龍前連續量測兩端間隙、高程與梁溫至少一個晝夜循環，建立間隙—溫度關係並預測合龍時段；鎖定後量測焊接前後的偏位與應變，臨時墩卸載時逐步記錄各支點反力與梁體高程，確認與施工階段分析一致。~Before closure, record gap, levels and steel temperature for at least one day–night cycle to build a gap–temperature relation and predict the window; after locking, measure offsets and strains before and after welding, and during temporary-tower unloading log support reactions and deck levels step by step against the staged analysis.
units.failure: 在溫度快速變化時強行焊接合龍，焊道冷卻中受拉而開裂或產生鎖入應力；臨時墩卸載順序錯誤則讓相鄰斜索或支承瞬間超載，梁體出現不預期的扭轉或局部屈曲。~Forcing a closure weld while temperatures change quickly can crack the cooling weld or lock in stresses; unloading temporary towers in the wrong order can momentarily overload neighbouring stays or bearings, causing unexpected twist or local buckling.
units.misconception: 兩段鋼梁對準後焊起來就完成合龍，之後的施工順序不影響結果。~Once the two deck ends are aligned and welded, closure is done and later sequence does not matter.
units.practice: 合龍與體系轉換應有獨立的程序書：鎖定時段、焊接順序、斜索張拉與臨時墩卸載的步驟與每步允許偏差；每一步完成後由監控小組比對量測與預測，偏差超過預警即暫停，由設計單位決定修正方案。~Closure and system change need a dedicated procedure: locking window, welding sequence, stay tensioning and temporary-tower unloading steps with tolerances; after each step the monitoring team compares measurements with predictions and stops at alert deviations, leaving the correction to the designer.

units.anchor: 斜索阻尼器與監測索~Stay dampers and instrumented stays
units.title: 斜索振動、阻尼與監測~Stay vibration, damping and monitoring
units.mechanism: 長斜索質量輕、本身阻尼很低，在風雨、渦流或橋面振動激勵下容易大幅振動。米約的斜索保護套表面有螺旋肋以抑制風雨振，每根索在橋面上方約 1 公尺處裝設阻尼器，頂推期間還曾以臨時橫向繫索提高頻率與阻尼。公開技術文章也指出，P3 南側有 6 根斜索裝設量測儀器，平均風速超過 15 m/s 或加速度超過 1.5 m/s² 時自動記錄，錨板上另有 12 個聲波感測器偵測斷絲。這些量測把設計假設轉成可追蹤的營運資料。~Long stays are light and have very low inherent damping, so rain–wind, vortex shedding or deck motion can drive large vibrations. Millau's sheaths carry helical ridges against rain–wind vibration, each stay has a damper about 1 m above the deck, and temporary cross-ties raised frequencies and damping during launching. A published paper adds that six stays on the south side of P3 are instrumented, recording automatically when mean wind exceeds 15 m/s or acceleration exceeds 1.5 m/s², and 12 acoustic sensors on anchor plates listen for wire breaks. These measurements turn design assumptions into traceable operating data.
units.model: 外加阻尼器最佳附加阻尼比約 ζ ≈ 0.5·x_d/L。取阻尼器距錨點 x_d = 2.5 m、索長 L = 120 m，ζ ≈ 0.5×2.5/120 ≈ 1.04%。Scruton 數 Sc = m·ζ/(ρ·D²)，m = 100 kg/m、D = 0.25 m、ρ = 1.25 kg/m³，Sc = 100×0.0104/(1.25×0.0625) ≈ 13.3，高於常用的風雨振門檻 10。數值為教學假設。~An external damper gives an optimum added damping ratio of about ζ ≈ 0.5·x_d/L. With x_d = 2.5 m from the anchorage and L = 120 m, ζ ≈ 0.5×2.5/120 ≈ 1.04%. The Scruton number Sc = m·ζ/(ρ·D²) with m = 100 kg/m, D = 0.25 m and ρ = 1.25 kg/m³ is Sc = 100×0.0104/(1.25×0.0625) ≈ 13.3, above the commonly used rain–wind threshold of 10. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 安裝阻尼器前後分別做自由衰減試驗（以繩索拉離後釋放），量測各階模態的阻尼比，與設計目標比較；營運中定期下載監測索的加速度與風速紀錄，確認觸發事件的振幅、頻率與風況，聲波事件則逐一比對位置與時間。~Run free-decay tests (pull with a rope and release) before and after damper installation, measuring modal damping ratios against the target; in service download instrumented-stay accelerations with wind records to examine triggered events by amplitude, frequency and wind condition, and locate and time-stamp every acoustic event.
units.failure: 阻尼器漏油、連接鬆脫或被誤鎖時，附加阻尼消失，斜索在特定風雨條件下大幅振動，錨具與保護套承受反覆彎折；聲波系統若無人判讀，斷絲事件會被忽略直到目視發現。~A leaking, loose or accidentally locked damper removes the added damping, so the stay vibrates strongly in certain rain–wind conditions and anchorages and sheaths are flexed repeatedly; an acoustic system nobody interprets lets wire breaks go unnoticed until visual inspection finds them.
units.misconception: 斜索阻尼器越靠近橋面中央越有效，位置不重要。~Stay dampers work equally well anywhere, so their position does not matter.
units.practice: 阻尼器應列入定期檢查清單（漏油、連接、行程痕跡），每次檢查後抽測衰減；監測系統要指定負責判讀的人員、觸發後的通報流程與資料保存期限，並與斜索檢查結果交叉比對。~Dampers belong on the routine checklist for leaks, connections and stroke marks, with spot decay tests after inspections; the monitoring system needs named analysts, a notification flow after triggers and a data-retention period, cross-checked against stay inspections.

units.anchor: 完工載重試驗車隊~Completion test truck fleet
units.title: 通車前載重試驗與量測~Pre-opening load test and measurement
units.mechanism: 公開資料顯示米約高架橋於 2004 年 11 月 17 日開始載重試驗，同年 12 月通車。對多跨斜張橋而言，載重試驗不只是量跨中撓度，更重要的是確認不對稱載重下的塔頂位移、斜索索力變化與墩頂轉角是否符合模型，因為這正是多跨體系的關鍵行為。鋼梁對溫度很敏感，日照會讓頂板比底板熱，產生與載重同量級的撓度，因此量測必須搭配溫度紀錄或選在溫度穩定的時段。~Public records show Millau's load testing began on 17 November 2004, with opening in December. For a multi-span cable-stayed bridge, the test is not only about mid-span deflection but about confirming pylon-top sway, stay-force changes and pier-head rotation under unbalanced load against the model, since this is the system's defining behaviour. A steel deck is very temperature-sensitive: sun heats the top plate more than the bottom and causes deflections as large as the test load's, so measurements need temperature records or a thermally stable time window.
units.model: 假設一跨 342 m 上放置 20 輛、每輛 32 t 的試驗車，總載重 P = 20×32×9.81 ≈ 6,278 kN，相當於 6,278/342 ≈ 18.4 kN/m，約為鋼梁自重 143.6 kN/m 的 12.8%。只載一跨、相鄰跨空載時，可檢驗多跨體系最不利的不對稱反應。車數與車重為教學假設。~Assume 20 trucks of 32 t on one 342 m span: P = 20×32×9.81 ≈ 6,278 kN, or 6,278/342 ≈ 18.4 kN/m, about 12.8% of the 143.6 kN/m steel deck self-weight. Loading one span with neighbours empty tests the multi-span system's most unfavourable unbalanced response. Truck count and weight are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 試驗計畫依模型選定加載排列，量測項目包含跨中撓度、塔頂位移（GNSS 或全站儀）、代表性斜索索力與墩頂傾斜，並同步記錄梁溫；以實測與預測比值及卸載後回復情形作為允收依據，結果成為竣工基準。~Choose load arrangements from the model and measure mid-span deflection, pylon-top sway by GNSS or total station, selected stay forces and pier-head tilt while logging deck temperature; accept on the ratio of measured to predicted values and recovery after unloading, and keep the results as the as-built baseline.
units.failure: 只量撓度而不量索力與塔頂位移，可能錯過斜索索力分配偏離設計的情況；在日照劇烈時段試驗而不修正溫度，會把熱變形誤認為結構勁度問題，導致錯誤的調索或補強決策。~Measuring deflection alone while ignoring stay forces and pylon sway can miss a stay-force distribution that departs from design; testing in strong sun without temperature correction can mistake thermal movement for a stiffness problem and trigger wrong retensioning or strengthening.
units.misconception: 載重試驗只要量跨中撓度就能證明多跨斜張橋的性能。~Measuring mid-span deflection alone proves the performance of a multi-span cable-stayed bridge.
units.practice: 試驗前公布車輛過磅紀錄、加載排列與停止條件，試驗中由獨立量測團隊與設計代表即時比對；試驗報告須附溫度修正方法與原始資料，交給營運單位作為長期監測的零點。~Publish weighbridge tickets, load arrangements and stop criteria before testing, compare results in real time with an independent survey team and the designer's representative, and attach the temperature-correction method and raw data to the report as the zero point for long-term monitoring.

units.anchor: 正交異性橋面焊縫~Orthotropic deck welds
units.title: 鋼橋面疲勞與鋪面~Steel deck fatigue and surfacing
units.mechanism: 正交異性鋼橋面直接承受車輪荷載，頂板只有十幾公釐厚（公開資料：12 至 14 mm），輪載在加勁肋與頂板的焊縫、加勁肋穿過橫隔板的開孔處產生局部彎曲應力；每一輛重車通過都是一次應力循環，數十年累積下來就是疲勞問題。鋪面不只是行車表面，它與鋼板共同作用可以分散輪壓、降低焊縫應力幅，同時保護鋼板免於水與除冰鹽。因此鋪面材料、厚度與黏結品質都是疲勞設計的一部分，而不是後期才決定的裝修項目。~An orthotropic steel deck carries wheel loads directly through a top plate only about a dozen millimetres thick (published: 12 to 14 mm), so wheels cause local bending stresses at rib-to-deck welds and at rib cut-outs in the diaphragms; every heavy vehicle is a stress cycle, and decades of them make fatigue the governing issue. Surfacing is not just a running layer: acting with the plate it spreads wheel pressure, lowers weld stress ranges and protects the steel from water and de-icing salt. Surfacing material, thickness and bond quality are therefore part of fatigue design, not a finish chosen later.
units.model: S–N 曲線 N = 2×10⁶·(Δσ_C/Δσ)³。細節類別 Δσ_C = 71 MPa、實際應力幅 Δσ = 50 MPa 時，N = 2×10⁶×(71/50)³ ≈ 5.73×10⁶ 次；若鋪面劣化使應力幅升到 60 MPa，N ≈ 3.31×10⁶ 次，壽命約減少 42%。數值為教學假設。~S–N curve N = 2×10⁶·(Δσ_C/Δσ)³. For detail category Δσ_C = 71 MPa and an actual range Δσ = 50 MPa, N = 2×10⁶×(71/50)³ ≈ 5.73×10⁶ cycles; if degraded surfacing raises the range to 60 MPa, N ≈ 3.31×10⁶ cycles, about 42% less life. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以應變計量測重車通過時加勁肋焊縫附近的應力歷時，用雨流計數換算等效應力幅，與設計假設比較；定期以目視、磁粒或相位陣列超音波檢查焊趾與開孔處的裂紋，並檢查鋪面裂縫、剝離與排水。~Strain-gauge rib welds under heavy traffic, convert the histories to equivalent stress ranges by rainflow counting and compare with design assumptions; periodically inspect weld toes and cut-outs by visual, magnetic-particle or phased-array ultrasonic testing, and check the surfacing for cracks, debonding and drainage.
units.failure: 焊趾裂紋若沿頂板厚度方向擴展，最後會在鋪面下貫穿頂板，水分從裂縫進入箱內造成腐蝕；鋪面剝離或車轍讓輪壓更集中，加速裂紋成長，形成惡性循環。~A weld-toe crack growing through the top plate eventually penetrates under the surfacing, letting water into the box and causing corrosion; debonded or rutted surfacing concentrates wheel pressure and speeds crack growth in a vicious circle.
units.misconception: 鋼橋面的疲勞只和鋼材強度有關，鋪面不會影響。~Steel deck fatigue depends only on steel strength; surfacing has no effect.
units.practice: 維護計畫應把鋪面狀況與焊縫檢查放在同一張表，重車車道與輪跡帶列為優先檢查區；鋪面更換時規定黏結層試驗與厚度允差，避免施工機具在鋼板上造成刻痕。~The maintenance plan should track surfacing condition and weld inspection together, prioritising heavy lanes and wheel paths; resurfacing specifications must include bond tests and thickness tolerances and protect the plate from gouging by equipment.

units.anchor: 球面支承與端部伸縮縫~Spherical bearings and end joints
units.title: 支承、伸縮縫與特許期維護~Bearings, joints and concession maintenance
units.mechanism: 鋼梁在各墩頂以支承傳力，公開資料記載使用新型球面支承，墩頂反力在不對稱載重與極端風況下可達約 100 MN，並需考慮上拔。梁的溫度伸縮在兩端橋台由伸縮縫吸收，伸縮量是全橋最大的。米約由 Eiffage 以特許經營方式興建與營運，鋼材供應商資料提到特許期含施工共 78 年；在這麼長的期間內，支承滑動面、伸縮縫、斜索與塗裝都要更換或翻修，因此設計時就必須預留頂升點、更換空間與交通維持方式。~The deck bears on each pier head through bearings; published data mention a new type of spherical bearing, pier-head reactions up to about 100 MN under unbalanced loads and extreme wind, and uplift to be considered. Thermal movement is taken by expansion joints at the two abutments, which see the bridge's largest movements. Millau was built and is operated by Eiffage under a concession that the steel supplier reports as 78 years including construction; over such a period, bearing sliding surfaces, joints, stays and coatings must be replaced or refurbished, so jacking points, replacement space and traffic arrangements must be designed in from the start.
units.model: PTFE 滑動球面支承在低溫時摩擦係數取 μ = 0.03，墩頂反力 N = 100 MN，滑動時傳到墩頂的水平力 F = μ·N = 0.03×100 = 3 MN。橋台處以中央為不動點、半長 1,230 m、溫差 35 °C，伸縮量 ΔL = 1.2×10⁻⁵×1,230×35 ≈ 0.52 m。μ 與溫差為教學假設。~For a PTFE spherical sliding bearing at low temperature take μ = 0.03; with a pier-head reaction N = 100 MN, sliding transfers F = μ·N = 0.03×100 = 3 MN horizontally to the pier head. At an abutment, with the deck fixed at the centre, a half-length of 1,230 m and a 35 °C range give ΔL = 1.2×10⁻⁵×1,230×35 ≈ 0.52 m. μ and the temperature range are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 定期量測各支承的滑動位置與傾角、伸縮縫開口與梁溫，繪出位移—溫度關係判斷是否卡滯；支承更換前以頂升試驗確認反力與千斤頂位置，伸縮縫檢查齒板、防水帶與錨栓。~Regularly measure bearing displacements and rotations, joint openings and deck temperature, plotting movement against temperature to detect seizure; before replacing a bearing confirm the reaction and jack positions by a trial lift, and inspect joint fingers, seals and anchors.
units.failure: 支承滑動面磨耗或被異物卡住時，溫度力無法釋放，墩頂水平力遠超設計值，薄肢橋墩可能開裂；伸縮縫錨固鬆脫則在重車衝擊下逐步破壞並讓水進入箱梁端部。~A worn or obstructed sliding surface stops thermal relief, so horizontal force at the pier head far exceeds design and the slender shafts may crack; loose joint anchorage fails progressively under heavy-vehicle impact and lets water into the box ends.
units.misconception: 支承與伸縮縫是耐用到設計年限的永久構件，不需要規劃更換。~Bearings and joints are permanent parts that last the full design life without planned replacement.
units.practice: 特許營運的維護手冊應列出可更換構件清單、頂升點與容許頂升量、更換時的交通配置與天候限制；每次更換後更新竣工資料與監測基準，並在特許期末交接時提供完整的構件履歷。~The concession maintenance manual should list replaceable components, jacking points and permitted lifts, traffic layouts and weather limits for replacement; after each replacement update as-built records and monitoring baselines, and hand over complete component histories at the end of the concession.

example: 頂推設計練習：鋼梁自重 w = 36,000 t / 2,460 m ≈ 14.6 t/m，即約 143.6 kN/m。頂推到臨時墩前，若無鼻樑，171 m 懸臂根部彎矩 M₀ = w·L²/2 = 143.6×171²/2 ≈ 2.10×10⁶ kN·m。改用 40 m、30 kN/m 的鋼鼻樑時，鋼梁懸臂只剩 131 m：M = 143.6×131²/2 + 30×40×(131 + 20) ≈ 1.232×10⁶ + 0.181×10⁶ ≈ 1.41×10⁶ kN·m，減少約 33%。南段 1,743 m 鋼梁重約 1,743×143.6 ≈ 250,000 kN；若滑動摩擦 μ = 0.03、縱坡 i = 3.025%，向上坡推需 F ≈ W·(μ + i) ≈ 15,100 kN，向下坡則 W·(μ − i) ≈ 0，表示梁會自行下滑，必須設置制動與反推。由此可見輕量鼻樑與頂推斜索比推力大小更關鍵，控制量是懸臂根部彎矩與下坡時的制動。鼻樑長度、重量與摩擦係數為教學假設，不代表米約的實際設計。~Launching exercise: the steel deck weighs w = 36,000 t / 2,460 m ≈ 14.6 t/m, about 143.6 kN/m. Before reaching a temporary tower, a 171 m cantilever without a nose has a root moment M₀ = w·L²/2 = 143.6×171²/2 ≈ 2.10×10⁶ kN·m. With a 40 m nose weighing 30 kN/m, only 131 m of deck cantilevers: M = 143.6×131²/2 + 30×40×(131 + 20) ≈ 1.232×10⁶ + 0.181×10⁶ ≈ 1.41×10⁶ kN·m, about 33% less. The 1,743 m south section weighs about 1,743×143.6 ≈ 250,000 kN; with sliding friction μ = 0.03 and gradient i = 3.025%, pushing uphill needs F ≈ W·(μ + i) ≈ 15,100 kN, while downhill W·(μ − i) ≈ 0, meaning the deck would run away by itself and needs braking and restraint. The comparison shows why a light nose and launching stays matter more than raw pushing capacity: the critical quantities are the root moment and the restraint of a deck that wants to slide downhill. Nose length, weight and friction are teaching assumptions, not Millau's actual design.
history: 法國 A75 高速公路需要跨越米約附近的塔恩河谷，經過十多年的研究與方案比選，最後採用工程師 Michel Virlogeux 與建築師 Norman Foster 的多跨斜張方案，由 Eiffage 以特許經營方式融資、興建與營運。2001 年底開工，2003 年 3 月首段鋼梁頂推出平台，2004 年 5 月 28 日南北鋼梁接合，同年 12 月 14 日落成、16 日通車，2006 年獲國際橋梁及結構工程協會傑出結構獎。其工程新意在於六個連續 342 公尺主跨的多跨斜張體系、上部分叉的高墩，以及以臨時鋼墩與同步頂推器在高空頂推 36,000 公噸鋼梁。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何設計文件。~France's A75 motorway had to cross the Tarn valley near Millau, and after more than a decade of studies and option comparisons, the multi-span cable-stayed scheme of engineer Michel Virlogeux and architect Norman Foster was chosen, financed, built and operated by Eiffage under a concession. Work began in late 2001, the first deck section was launched off its platform in March 2003, the north and south decks met on 28 May 2004, and the bridge was inaugurated on 14 December and opened on 16 December 2004, later receiving the IABSE Outstanding Structure Award in 2006. Its novelty lies in a multi-span cable-stayed system with six continuous 342 m spans, tall piers that split near the top, and launching a 36,000 t steel deck at height over temporary steel towers with synchronised launching units. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any design documents.
facts: 全長 2,460 公尺，共 8 跨：兩端 204 公尺與六個 342 公尺主跨~Total length 2,460 m in 8 spans: two 204 m end spans and six 342 m main spans
最高的 P2 墩約 245 公尺，P3 約 221 公尺，塔頂高程距河谷 343 公尺~The tallest pier P2 is about 245 m and P3 about 221 m, with the pylon tops 343 m above the valley
七座鋼塔各高約 87 公尺，全橋共 154 根斜索~Seven steel pylons about 87 m tall carry 154 stays in all
每根斜索 55 至 91 股直徑 15.7 mm、1,860 MPa 鋼絞線，斜索鋼材約 1,500 公噸~Each stay has 55 to 91 strands of 15.7 mm and 1,860 MPa, with about 1,500 t of stay steel
鋼箱梁約 36,000 公噸，深 4.20 公尺、寬約 32 公尺~The steel box deck weighs about 36,000 t and is 4.20 m deep and about 32 m wide
約一半鋼材為 460 MPa 等級的 DI-MC 460，約 18,000 公噸~About half of the steel, about 18,000 t, is the 460 MPa grade DI-MC 460
鋼梁由南岸頂推約 1,743 公尺、北岸約 717 公尺，最高臨時墩約 170–180 公尺~The deck was launched about 1,743 m from the south and 717 m from the north, over temporary towers up to roughly 170–180 m tall
公開資料指出頂推器每循環推進約 600 mm、約 4 分鐘~Trade reports cite about 600 mm of travel per launching cycle in about four minutes
